purpose: Teach: 増員/測る/オーブン/カルテ/当番/仕上げる/仕切り/引き換え

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 増員、若い頃も、慎重に進めた。
lines.en: When I was young, we were careful about hiring too.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried opening. Voice settles into reflection without strain. Slight pause before 'too'—acknowledging the parallel he's drawing. Weight on 'careful,' not lecturing but sharing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。業績、定量的に測る基準、設けています。
lines.en: Yes. We've established clear, quantifiable standards for measuring performance.
lines.style: Steady, professional tone. Slight forward lean in the delivery. Precise enunciation on 'standards' and 'measurable'—showing he knows this matters. Warm underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、業務用オーブン、扱いに苦労した。
lines.en: In my early days, handling commercial-grade equipment was difficult.
lines.style: Quiet nostalgia. Gentle smile in the voice. Slow cadence on 'commercial equipment'—the memory taking its time. Soft trailing-off, like he's standing in that moment again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。顧客カルテ、歴史、社史にも残しています。
lines.en: Yes. We keep detailed customer records going back through our company history.
lines.style: Calm pride in the voice. Deliberate pace on 'customer records' and 'company history'—these are anchors. No rush. The satisfaction of institutional memory well-kept.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 役員当番、若い頃から、回り持ちでやった。
lines.en: When I was young, we rotated executive duties among the staff.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm. Slight emphasis on 'rotated'—showing it was deliberate, not happenstance. Conversational pace. The voice of someone comfortable with hard decisions made fairly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。事業を仕上げる責任、感じています。
lines.en: Yes. I feel the responsibility to see this business through to completion.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The opening words held steady—'I feel the responsibility'—no apology, no performance. Slow pace. Voice firms slightly on 'completion,' then settles.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 仕切りの上手な人、組織の柱だ。
lines.en: A person who can lead well becomes the backbone of the organization.
lines.style: Declarative but not harsh. Slight nod in the voice at 'lead well.' Measured pace. The weight of 'backbone' lands with quiet emphasis—a truth stated plainly, meant to land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。長年の信頼、引き換えに、顧客から、信用、頂いています。
lines.en: Yes. The trust built over these many years is what earns us the confidence of our customers.
lines.style: Thoughtful close. Slow, deliberate pace throughout. Slight warmth on 'trust built over many years.' Final clause—'confidence of customers'—delivered with quiet finality, as if completing a circle. Composed exhale.
